messages.subject: Global Executive Profile | Mining, Energy, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear IRC Global Executive Search Partners Team,

Your international retained-search network makes this a focused introduction for cross-border leadership mandates. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments across mining, energy, infrastructure and industrial investment. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration across your relevant member firms and practices.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
